g.text: All user-owned tables carry owner_id and are
read through owner-scoped EF Core query filters.
status : pending | approved | rejected | expired | superseded
type : fact | preference | event | procedure | person | device
kind : supersedes | contradicts | depends_on | relates_to | links_to «PK»
trigger_kind : now | at | cron | event | after
status : pending | running | waiting | done | failed | cancelled
status : starting | running | done | failed | cancelled
outcome : delivered | coalesced | held | expired | fallback
